spans.s:
नौक (at the end of an adj. comp.) = 3. नौ; (आ),
f. a small boat or ship; N. of a commentary on the
Mantra-mahodadhi by Mahī-dhara.
—नौकाकृष्ट
(˚का-आक्˚), अम्, n., N. of a favourable position of
the pieces in the game Catur-aṅga; [cf. नृपा-
कृष्ट.]
—नौका-दण्ड, अस्, m. ‘boat-pole,’ an
oar, a paddle.
